metadata.description: Video editing skills built on the EditAtlas library of techniques, templates, styles and sound effects

plugins.name: editable-export
plugins.description: An editable copy of a finished video, built from its elements, that opens in the EditAtlas studio: fix small things on a timeline and export the MP4 again in the browser

plugins.name: sound-design
plugins.description: Sound-design a finished video with real sound effects from the EditAtlas library, with a numeric check before delivery

plugins.name: transcribe
plugins.description: Word-level transcripts with local Whisper, checked with you, with subtitles and a cut list for silences, fillers and retakes

plugins.name: video-breakdown
plugins.description: Break down a reference video shot by shot and name each transition, camera move, text style and sound with its EditAtlas technique, plus a recipe

plugins.name: video-check
plugins.description: Check a finished render before anyone sees it: file spec, black, frozen and stray frames, loops, loudness and clipping, phone-size sheets for a fresh review, then fix and check again
